name: broll
description: Voiceover-driven B-roll edit. The narration is the spine: clean the voiceover, index the footage library at shot granularity, then assemble visuals that illustrate what is being said. Produces a normal draft with muted footage on tracks[0] and the cleaned voiceover on audio.tracks[0].
notes: TWO INDEPENDENT PATHS that meet at `assemble`. (1) The AUDIO path — every vo_* step declares input: voiceover.src and touches ONLY the voiceover. Never run them over the footage clips. It runs on project.voiceover.src directly, audio file or video, with no audio-extraction step: waveform_trim takes the file, every step after it takes the previous step's trim spec, and materialize_cut --audio emits the cleaned spine at the source's native rate and channel count, discarding the picture if the voiceover was a video. (2) The FOOTAGE path — probe, detect_shots and shot_sheet are foreach: clips and touch ONLY the footage. Never run them over the voiceover. There are two transcripts and they are not interchangeable: vo_script is pre-cut, in original-source time, and exists so select-takes can compare takes; vo_transcribe is post-cut, in output-timeline time, and is what the broll skill reads for beat segmentation and word-onset cut placement — and what montaj/overlay reads to sync overlays to speech. The voiceover contributes AUDIO ONLY: do not place project.voiceover.src on any visual track unless the editing prompt explicitly asks for it. All tracks[0] items are muted. Horizontal sources are centre-cropped via sourceCrop, never letterboxed. The broll skill writes tracks[0] and audio only; montaj/overlay runs last and owns tracks[1+], deciding overlays from the editing prompt.
